# Solstice entrance symbols

Use a short cue such as **Bass in** above the first beat the player should sound.
Use the bass clef for bass, a snare for drums, keys for piano, the acoustic
guitar for guitar and the violin for violin. Keep the label when a symbol first
appears. The SVGs are transparent, monochrome and scalable.

- [Drum](https://lucide.dev/icons/drum), [Piano](https://lucide.dev/icons/piano)
  and [Guitar](https://lucide.dev/icons/guitar): Lucide, distributed under
  the terms in LICENSE-Lucide.
- [Music Clef Bass](https://pictogrammers.com/library/mdi/icon/music-clef-bass/)
  and [Violin](https://pictogrammers.com/library/mdi/icon/violin/): Material
  Design Icons by Pictogrammers, Apache License 2.0. Adaptations add accessible
  titles and a currentColor fill. See LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt.
